# Universal Quantum Work

One source-independent sequence of exact thermal operations attains the full relative-entropy work rate for every fixed unknown iid source with finite D(rho||tau), a known discrete Hamiltonian, and a finite Gibbs partition function. The central physical case is every finite-energy harmonic-oscillator state, without a supplied energy bound or tail envelope.

## Reader routes

- Overview and physical question: README.md, science/README.md.
- Exact assumptions, quantifiers, and battery conventions: science/model_theorem.md.
- The thermal replacement channel and its relative-entropy limit: science/thermal_cutoff.md.
- The uniform finite-dimensional extractor and explicit Gibbs-only dilation: science/finite_extraction.md.
- Training, target grids, finite output alphabet, and source-independent stage schedule: science/universal_protocol.md.
- Optimal reliable work rate and initial battery accounting: science/converse.md.
- Exact-label impossibility, residual entropy bound, and sharpness qualifications: science/output_boundary.md.
- Coherence, slow tails, and the absence of a uniform mean-energy-class sample guarantee: science/oscillator.md.
- Inherited ingredients and comparison with primary literature: references/related_work.md, references/source_register.md, references/bibliography.bib.
- Reproduction commands, finite checks, and their limits: verification/README.md, verification/check_protocol.py.

## Essential distinctions

The all-n guarantee is convergence of work density in mean absolute deviation, hence also in probability and mean. The exact-energy-label guarantee uses a source-dependent favorable subsequence and the ordered lim_epsilon->0 limsup_n criterion. Do not replace it by exact-label concentration along every n.

At each n the battery is diagonal with a finite alphabet. Two coarse-grid energies carry nearly all probability, and the total entropy is at most ln(2)+o(1). These need not be neighboring oscillator levels. The entropy lower bound is a residual-source limsup statement on a continuous commuting family, not an all-source or almost-everywhere entropy tax.

The finite-dimensional ingredient is uniform in the source at fixed dimension and margin. Recovery of the original relative entropy is pointwise in the infinite-dimensional source. A mean-energy bound alone does not give a uniform finite-sample guarantee.

The processor counts all training specimens, starts a single fixed oscillator battery at its ground level, and uses only Gibbs-initialized auxiliary systems. It supplies no catalyst, free pure memory, phase reference, or work loan. Bath size, energy, control complexity, and running time are unrestricted and can grow rapidly.

Keep the public account scientific. Each theorem and proof has an authoritative topic page; navigation and summaries should preserve its assumptions and limiting order.
